feed.title: State Employment and Unemployment (Monthly)
feed.subtitle: "The State Employment and Unemployment (LAUS) release has estimates of labor force and unemployment for census regions and divisions, states, and selected metropolitan statistical areas. The release also contains Current Employment Statistics estimates of employment by state and industry division. Issued monthly. For more information, see www.bls.gov/lau/ and www.bls.gov/sae/. "

entry.title: July jobless rates down in 10 states; payroll jobs up in 1 state, down in 1
entry.content: In July, unemployment rates were lower in 10 states and stable in 40 states and the District of Columbia. Nonfarm payroll employment increased in 1 state, decreased in 1 state, and was essentially unchanged in 48 states and the District.

entry.title: June jobless rates down in 8 states, up in 2; payroll jobs up in 3 states, down in 1
entry.content: In June, unemployment rates were lower in 8 states, higher in 2 states, and stable in 40 states and the District of Columbia. Nonfarm payroll employment increased in 3 states, decreased in 1, and was essentially unchanged in 46 states and the District.

entry.title: May jobless rates down in 6 states, up in 2; payroll jobs up in 2 states
entry.content: In May, unemployment rates were lower in 6 states, higher in 2 states, and stable in 42 states and the District of Columbia. Nonfarm payroll employment increased in 2 states and was essentially unchanged in 48 states and the District.

entry.title: April jobless rates down in 3 states, up in 2; payroll jobs up in 6 states
entry.content: In April, unemployment rates were lower in 3 states, higher in 2 states, and stable in 45 states and the District of Columbia. Nonfarm payroll employment increased in 6 states and was essentially unchanged in 44 states and the District.

entry.title: March jobless rates change little in all states; payroll jobs up in 3 states
entry.content: In March, unemployment rates were little changed in all 50 states and the District of Columbia. Nonfarm payroll employment increased in 3 states and was essentially unchanged in 47 states and the District.

entry.title: February jobless rate up in 1 state; payroll jobs down in 2 states, up in 1
entry.content: In February, unemployment rates were higher in 1 state and stable in 49 states and the District of Columbia. Nonfarm payroll employment decreased in 2 states, increased in 1 state, and was essentially unchanged in 47 states and the District.

entry.title: January jobless rate up in 1 state; payroll jobs up in 5 states, down in D.C.
entry.content: In January, unemployment rates were higher in 1 state and stable in 49 states and the District of Columbia. Nonfarm payroll employment increased in 5 states, decreased in the District, and was essentially unchanged in 45 states.

entry.title: December jobless rates up in 6 states; payroll jobs essentially unchanged in all states
entry.content: In December, unemployment rates were higher in 6 states and stable in 44 states and the District of Columbia. Nonfarm payroll employment was essentially unchanged in all 50 states and the District.

entry.title: November payroll jobs essentially unchanged; South Dakota has the lowest jobless rate
entry.content: In November, unemployment rates were higher than a year earlier in 16 states and the District of Columbia, lower in 8 states, and little different in 26 states. Nonfarm payroll employment was essentially unchanged over the month in all 50 states and the District.

entry.title: Sept. jobless rates up in 8 states, down in 2; payroll jobs up in 1 state, down in 1
entry.content: In September, unemployment rates were higher in 8 states, lower in 2 states, and stable in 40 states and the District of Columbia. Nonfarm payroll employment increased in 1 state, decreased in 1 state, and was essentially unchanged in 48 states and the District.

entry.title: August jobless rates up in 3 states, down in 2; payroll jobs up in 1 state
entry.content: In August, unemployment rates were higher in 3 states, lower in 2 states, and stable in 45 states and the District of Columbia. Nonfarm payroll employment increased in 1 state, decreased in the District, and was essentially unchanged in 49 states.

entry.title: July jobless rates down in 2 states, up in 1; payroll jobs up in 4 states
entry.content: In July, unemployment rates were lower in 2 states, higher in 1 state, and stable in 47 states and the District of Columbia. Nonfarm payroll employment increased in 4 states and was essentially unchanged in 46 states and the District.
